I opened PR #58 (https://github.com/cv/pi-action/pull/58), which closes #57. It adds one line to the `Run pi-action` step of `.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml`:

```yaml
model_tools_hidden: read, write, edit, bash
```

After this, the model gets only pit's `typescript` tool. I haven't tested it in a run, and the workflow check didn't run because `npx actionlint` couldn't find the tool here. On the next run, the `🤖` log line should read `tools: typescript`.

**Why not `exclude_tools`:** that input turns the tools off completely, so pit's programs couldn't use `read`/`write`/`edit`/`bash` through `tools.*` either. `model_tools_hidden` only hides them from the model.

**Not changed:** `pi-direct-dogfood.yml` and `pi-pr-review-dogfood.yml` don't load pit. If they hid these tools, they would have none left and the run would fail.

**When it takes effect:** comment-triggered runs use the copy of this workflow on `main`, so the change applies once the PR is merged.
